title: Qualify proof reuse on the real T1 selftest-entrypoint check
objective: Qualify the WU01 effectiveness harness against the real reusable T1 SELFTEST_ENTRYPOINT_CHECK, bind every relevant active-AWU and T1 implementation input into exact proof material, add adversarial qualification, and execute the measurement in bootstrap without integrating a production proof cache.
non_goals: integrate proof reuse into production T1 execution
skip the canonical single-pass T1 check
reuse T0 T3 or T4 evidence
persist reusable proofs across jobs or external storage

required_invariants: repository qualification executes the real run_t1 SELFTEST_ENTRYPOINT_CHECK as the measured executor
the qualification diff contains at least one changed scripts/governance/selftest_*.py file and the real check must report it as inspected
proof material binds canonical project state active AWU all changed selftest files T1 policy proof policy effectiveness policy and transitive T1/resolver implementation files
proof parameters bind active AWU id scope_base_sha changed selftest path set and symbolic check id
first repository request executes the real T1 check once and second identical request reuses the PASS proof without a second executor call
canonical single-pass validation still executes independently; qualification does not skip or replace mandatory T1 work
changed input policy implementation parameters or environment cannot reuse the prior proof
T0 T3 T4 and forbidden subjects remain non-reusable
bootstrap qualification uses no network paid service external cache or larger runner
acceptance_criteria: generic WU01 self-check passes in bootstrap
repository qualification inspects the WU02 selftest file with the real T1 check
repository qualification reports baseline_executions=2 actual_executions=1 avoided_executions=1
repository qualification reports one EXACT_INPUT_MATCH hit and candidate_hit_rate=1.0
at least 12 adversarial effectiveness probes cover input policy implementation parameter environment FAIL-proof and forbidden-tier invalidation
canonical incremental validation and unnecessary-check detector remain CLEAN
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head

done_when: generic and repository-bound proof-reuse measurements both pass
real T1 executor calls are reduced from baseline two to measured one only inside the isolated qualification
all exact-input invalidation scenarios remain fail-closed
canonical validation remains CLEAN and unchanged
ENG-08.3 can transition to mandatory-cost qualification
